newsitem.title: USA: All-Comm boosts offer to 2.1 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: All-Comm boosts offer to 2.1 mln shares.

text.p: All-Comm Media Corp said on Monday it has increased the size of a planned common stock offering to 2.1 million shares from 1.5 million.

Of the total, 1.75 million shares are being sold by the company and 350,000 by selling stockholders. Cruttenden Roth Inc will act as lead manager. Previously, LT Lawrence & Co Inc had been picked to lead the offer. It is now a co-manager.

Separately, 1,386,056 common shares are being registered by stockholders -- none of whom are officers or directors -- for possible resale. Just over 1.29 million shares will be subject to "lock-up" provisions.
The lock-up clause prohibits the resale of the shares, for a minimum of nine months after the underwritten offering.
All-Com said some of of its security holders have agreed to a recapitalizaton plan after the underwritten offer closes.

Under the program, All-Comm's Series B Preferred Stock will be converted into 2.48 million common shares, the Series C Preferred Stock will be repurchased for $1 million and all accrued dividends on the Series B and Series C preferred will be converted into 28,130 common shares.

Also, warrants related to the Series C Preferred Stock, exercisable for 3,000,000 shares of common stock, will be exchanged for 600,000 shares of common stock and agreements to issue warrants exercisable for 1,038,503 shares of common stock will be rescinded. Finally, options held by two of All-Comm's principal executive officers to purchase 300,000 shares of common stock will be canceled.
All-Comm Media provides database management services, custom telemarketing/telefundraising services and other direct marketing services.
